override.tagline:
Turn your someday
into a plan.

script: Someday isn't a day. || It's not on your calendar, and it never will be. || So give your dream a real date. Publish my first novel, by 2027. || Break it into milestones. Outline the story. Finish draft one. Find ten beta readers. || Then pick one small action for today. Write five hundred words. || That's it. || Not someday. Today. || Dmyor turns your someday into a plan.
